$note: One corpus of stored workflow documents, graded by the backend's StoredWorkflowDocument
The rules L1 to L5 and L7 are the stored-text rules of the reader; named graph-reader rules are also pinned by cases here.
reads: 'definition', or 'parameters' (read as the workflow's input parameters).
text: the stored text. Each ⟨XXXX⟩ stands for the one UTF-16 unit XXXX, so a lone surrogate can be
written in a file both sides can parse.
fault: the first rule broken in document order, its RFC 6901 location ('#' steps into a port list held
as a string), the node it sits in, and the detail word for word. An L1 has no detail here, but for blank
text: its wording is each side's parser's.
sites: every port type site of an accepted document, in document order.
Both sides read the text character by character, so both see every rule, L3 included, and a document
breaking two rules is graded on the first in document order.
